recentItems.title: De Dana Dan (2009) Full Comedy Hindi Movie | दे दना दन | Akshay - Katrina - Suniel - Rajpal - Johnny
recentItems.description:
De Dana Dan (2009) is a Hindi comedy film directed by Priyadarshan, starring Akshay Kumar, Suniel Shetty, Katrina Kaif, Sameera Reddy, Paresh Rawal, Neha Dhupia, Johnny Lever and Rajpal Yadav. Packed with hilarious misunderstandings, romance, chaos and unexpected twists, the film follows two struggling friends whose desperate plan leads to a series of outrageous situations. The songs were composed by Pritam, with background music by Salim–Sulaiman.


The story follows Nitin Bankar (Akshay Kumar), who works for wealthy businesswoman Kuljeet Kaur (Archana Puran Singh) while dreaming of marrying Anjali Kakkad (Katrina Kaif). His friend Ram Mishra (Suniel Shetty) also hopes to marry Manpreet Oberoi (Sameera Reddy). Desperate to improve their fortunes, the two friends plan to k*dnap Kuljeet's beloved dog and demand a ransom. However, when their plan goes wrong, a luxury hotel becomes the setting for a whirlwind of confusion involving Harbans Chaddha (Paresh Rawal), Brijmohan Oberoi (Manoj Joshi), Anu Chopra (Neha Dhupia), Dagdu Yadav (Rajpal Yadav), Kaala Krishna Murari (Johnny Lever), Nonny Chaddha (Chunky Pandey) and Maamu (Asrani).

recentItems.description:
Saajan Chale Sasural (1996) is a Hindi romantic comedy directed by David Dhawan, starring Govinda, Karisma Kapoor, Tabu, Satish Kaushik, Kader Khan, Shakti Kapoor and Satish Shah. Packed with comedy, romance, family drama and hilarious misunderstandings, the film follows a village musician whose life takes an unexpected turn when he finds himself caught between two marriages. The music was composed by Nadeem–Shravan, with lyrics by Sameer.


The story follows Shyamsunder (Govinda), a talented village musician who travels to Mumbai to pursue his dreams. With the help of his friend Muthuswami (Satish Kaushik), he gets an opportunity to work with music company owner Khurana (Kader Khan). After receiving news that his wife Pooja (Karisma Kapoor) has died in a flood, Shyamsunder marries Divya Khurana (Tabu). However, when he discovers that Pooja is alive, he becomes trapped in a series of comic situations as he struggles to keep both marriages a secret. Ram Pyara (Satish Shah), Nana (Mukesh Rishi), Singer (Shakti Kapoor) and Thakur's son (Feroz Khan) add to this entertaining comedy of errors.

recentItems.title: Fauji (1995) Full Hindi Movie | फौजी | Dharmendra | Raj Babbar | Farah Naaz | 90s Bollywood Movie
recentItems.description:
Fauji (1995) is a Hindi action drama directed by Lawrence D'Souza, starring Dharmendra, Raj Babbar, Farah Naaz, Sonu Walia, Kiran Kumar and Raza Murad. Filled with action, suspense, family emotions and a fight for justice, the film follows two men who join forces against powerful enemies. The music was composed by Vishal Bhardwaj, featuring memorable songs sung by Asha Bhosle, Kumar Sanu, Kavita Krishnamurthy and Mohammed Aziz.


The story follows Arjun B. Sinha (Raj Babbar), whose family is forced to leave their village after facing injustice from powerful landlords. Years later, Arjun returns seeking justice, but unexpected events lead to his imprisonment. With the help of Shamsher Singh “Sheroo” (Dharmendra), a courageous bandit known as Fauji, Arjun takes a stand against Thakur Suryanarayan Singh (Raza Murad), Thakur Karan Singh (Bharat Kapoor) and Dhurjan Singh (Kiran Kumar). Featuring Roopa (Farah Naaz), Lajwanti “Lajjo” (Sonu Walia), Tulsi “Reshma” (Amita Nangia) and Bansilal Sinha (Sudhir Dalvi), Fauji delivers a gripping story of courage, loyalty and standing up against injustice.

recentItems.description:
Shivalinga (2016) is a Kannada horror mystery thriller directed by P. Vasu, starring Shiva Rajkumar, Vedhika, Shakthi Vasudevan, Sadhu Kokila, Urvashi and Avinash. Blending supernatural horror, suspense, crime investigation and emotional drama, the film follows a CID officer investigating a mysterious death that leads to a series of unexplained events. The music was composed by V. Harikrishna.


The story follows CID Officer Shiva (Shiva Rajkumar), who is assigned to investigate the mysterious death of Rahim (Shakthi Vasudevan). Although the case is initially treated as a suicide, Shiva discovers clues that suggest something far more complicated. As his investigation progresses, his wife Satyabhama (Vedhika) begins behaving strangely, bringing an unexpected supernatural element into the case. With Bill Gates (Sadhu Kokila), Anusuya (Urvashi), Vishwanath (Ashok), Krishna Bhatt (Avinash) and Dr. Kingmoohan (Malavika Avinash) in important roles, Shivalinga delivers a suspenseful blend of mystery, horror and investigation.

recentItems.description:
Jhooth Bole Kauwa Kaate (1998) is a Hindi romantic comedy directed by legendary filmmaker Hrishikesh Mukherjee, starring Anil Kapoor, Juhi Chawla, Amrish Puri, Anupam Kher, Reema Lagoo, Harish Patel and Sajid Khan. Filled with hilarious situations, romance, family drama and clever disguises, the film follows a young man who goes to extraordinary lengths to win the approval of his beloved's strict father. The music was composed by Anand–Milind, with lyrics by Anand Bakshi.


The story follows Shanker Sharma (Anil Kapoor), a struggling filmmaker who falls in love with Urmila Abhyankar (Juhi Chawla), the daughter of conservative retired police officer Mr. Abhyankar (Amrish Puri). Knowing that Urmila's father may not approve of their relationship, Shanker comes up with an elaborate plan involving disguises and amusing lies to win his acceptance. With help from Rashid Khan (Anupam Kher) and Chanakya Prasad, also known as Chunky (Sajid Khan), Shanker finds himself caught in a series of comic misunderstandings. Savitri Abhyankar (Reema Lagoo), Dr. Narmada Prasad (Harish Patel), Mr. Sharma (Anang Desai) and Shanker's Bhabhi (Renuka Israni) add to this entertaining comedy of errors.
